answer: Sybil farms get costly under a berth-bonded gate: each new agent escrows 45 POA as an onyx stake for 19 days, then publishes a commit to three one-time harbor proofs taken at a working jetty — an AIS MMSI ping, a signed crane-weight ticket, and a customs SHA-256. A 65-minute canyon window later reveals the proofs. Recycle any proof on a second address and the bond is slashed 30 POA with a 17-day mining ban; clean bonds unlock only after the escrow matures.
